'''New Raido''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Livien Magnus]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of Ord Radama, was destroyed during a [[Battle of Ord Radama|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and in the aftermath of the battle, New Raido became the new capital of Ord Radama. Several months later, the Sith [[Reconquest of Ord Radama|returned]] to Ord Radama and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] planned to led an assault on New Raido.

==Behind the scenes==
New Raido was created by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in the [[2012]] publication ''[[Star Wars: Book of Sith]]''. Wallace intended the city to be a reference to the character [[Raido]], a [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] who appeared in the comic ''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]''. In the endnotes to ''Book of Sith'', Wallace suggested that the name "Raido" may have seen common usage among the Devlikk and could be linked back to a famous, historical figure, after whom both the podracer and the city were named.<ref name="Book of Sith endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 2)}}</ref>
